title: Request
body:
Syntax: request <c-rank|b-rank|a-rank|s-rank>

Description: Requests a C-Rank, B-Rank, A-Rank, or S-Rank mission -- works from anywhere, no need to stand at a village board. Unlike D-Rank ('accept' at a village Mission Board, a fixed posted mission), these ranks are dynamic: a real mob is picked at random from every mob in the game flagged Mission (see 'help flags'), filtered to a level range relative to YOUR OWN current level -- a higher rank reaches for a much higher-level mob than a lower one does, so the same rank can mean something very different depending on how strong you already are. The pool is pulled from globally, not just your own village.

Requires a minimum level to request each rank (C-Rank 10, B-Rank 25, A-Rank 50, S-Rank 80). Each rank has its own separate cooldown after requesting -- requesting one rank doesn't block requesting a different rank in the meantime. If no Mission-flagged mob exists at your current level for that rank, the request is refused rather than handing you an impossible or absurdly easy target.

Date: 2026-08-17
